data.rationale: The proposal follows the same sequence as the true workflow (Book, Hotels, destination, dates, Search, sort/filter, select hotel) with matching parameters, but it adds guest-setting and reserve steps in a different order and assumes a Booking.com partner page that the true workflow doesn't mention.
